traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Expansion meets power. Large-scale ambition, intense conviction, and a drive to overhaul inherited beliefs. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Conviction hardens into zealotry or overreach. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Growth and power reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Big, transformative ambition; the intensity can overshoot.
shadow: Excess and overreach collides with control and obsession; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
base: An opportunity can become a power struggle when growth depends on someone else controlling the terms.

readerCopy.body: An opportunity can become a power struggle when growth depends on someone else controlling the terms. When Jupiter opposes Pluto, expansion meets concentrated leverage, making success, money, recognition, or access inseparable from who can approve, restrict, or withdraw it. The arrangement may still be valuable while creating a dependence that deserves attention. Growth looks different once the cost of keeping it includes giving another person or institution more control.
